content: Hi! How can I help you today? Are you looking to share some of your recent trip memories or organize your travel photos and videos?
Hi! Yes, I have a bunch of photos and videos from my trip to Portugal. I want to share them with friends, but I'm worried the videos are too large. Should I compress them?

That sounds like a wonderful adventure! To make things easy for your friends, I recommend creating a shared album, most platforms will automatically compress videos for online viewing, but you can also offer the originals for anyone who wants to download high-quality versions.
Great, I set up an album called 'Portugal Highlights' and uploaded everything. Should I add captions or anything extra?

Absolutely, captions make your album even more special and accessible! You can add simple captions describing each photo or video, and consider using the 'Edit captions' option for videos to add brief subtitles. This helps everyone, especially those with hearing differences.
I added a few captions, but I'm not sure about alt text. How should I write those?
Great initiative! For alt text, just include a short description of what's in the photo, like 'view of Lisbon rooftops at sunset.' This way, anyone using a screen reader can enjoy your memories too.
Thanks, I'll go back and add those. Is it okay to let people download the originals?

Definitely! Just make sure to set the album link to 'view only,' unless you want friends to upload their own photos too. You can remind them to click the 'Download original' button if they want the highest quality.
Done. Should I organize videos and photos into separate folders inside the album?

That's a smart idea! Creating subfolders, like 'Photos' and 'Videos,' makes it easier for everyone to browse and find what they're looking for. Just drag the files into the right folders and update your friends with the new album structure.
All set! The album is ready with captions, alt text, and organized folders. Should I send the link now?

Perfect work! Go ahead and share the album link. In your message, invite friends to visit the album, browse the folders, and download any photos or videos they want to keep. Let them know about the captions and alt text for accessibility, too.
Will do! Thanks for all your help.
You're so welcome! Enjoy reliving those memories with your friends, and let me know if you ever need more organizing or sharing tips in the future.
